company.name: Fincart
company.shortDescription: Fincart develops an e-commerce logistics, shipping management, and merchant financing platform to manage shipments across courier providers.
company.description:
Fincart is a logistics technology and financial technology company that develops an e-commerce logistics, shipping management, and merchant financing platform. The company enables online merchants to manage shipments across multiple courier providers through a unified platform while providing operational tools and financing solutions to help businesses improve delivery performance and scale.

Its platform combines multi-carrier shipping management, courier aggregation, order management, shipment tracking, delivery analytics, non-delivery management, customer communication, cash-on-delivery (COD) settlements, merchant financing, and e-commerce integrations into a single solution. Fincart also offers AI-powered courier recommendations, same-day and international shipping, WhatsApp-based order validation, return and exchange automation, customer support tools, and flexible financing based on merchants' shipping performance.
